title: Tenant geofence attestation runbook and evidence exporter
creator: Aisha Martinez
description: Create an operational runbook and automated evidence exporter for tenant geofence attestations on Dedicated capacity. The feature will generate cryptographically signed attestation bundles that prove tenant compute and storage locations, retention configuration snapshots, and isolation proof (network/iam boundaries). Bundles must be auditor-friendly (CSV + PDF summary + machine-readable JSON) and stored to a customer-specific evidence bucket and to Redwood's internal compliance archive. Goal: enable quarterly and on-demand attestations for enterprise customers with data residency requirements.
acceptance_criteria: A scheduled job can produce an attestation bundle for a single tenant containing: tenant metadata, mapped cloud region(s), ASNs, list of active nodes/pods with region tags, retention policy snapshot, and KV-cache residency markers.
Bundles are signed with a KMS-backed key and include a human-readable PDF summary and a machine-readable JSON; SHA256 checksums included.
Attestation exporter can publish bundles to a tenant-owned S3/GCS bucket and to Redwood's encrypted audit store with 7 year retention metadata.
Runbook outlines step-by-step investigation flow for failed attestations and automated remediation triggers (relabel nodes, re-route traffic, or open incident).
Console UI shows last attestation timestamp, status, and a download link for the latest signed bundle for tenants on Dedicated plans.
Performance: generating a bundle for a tenant with up to 2,000 concurrent connections completes within 45 minutes; incremental snapshots complete within 5 minutes.
Security review completed and cryptographic signing process documented in PKI section of security notebook.
Unit and end-to-end tests cover exporter, signing, and publish paths; integration tests validate sample auditor import flow.
tasks: Design attestation bundle schema (CSV fields, JSON schema, PDF template)
Implement tenant metadata collector: node list, region mapping, ASN lookup, storage locations
Build KMS signing service and integrate with key rotation policy
Exporter service: generate bundle, attach checksums, sign, publish to destinations
Console work: add Attestations panel with status, download, and re-run buttons
Runbook doc: on-call steps, remediation commands, escalation matrix
Automated tests and e2e test harness that validates bundle contents against ground truth
Security review and threat model update; obtain approvals for key usage and archive retention
